verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's pricing page lists "Custom-coded email templates" (mailchimp-docs-37), so hand-written HTML templates are a documented first-party capability. A community user also describes a Code module in the builder (mailchimp-comm-16). Nothing in the pack shows API endpoints for creating or updating templates, merge-tag or variable substitution, MJML support, or any workflow for keeping templates under version control. Missing for 10: a documented template-management API, variable/merge-tag substitution, MJML support, a version-control or templates-as-code workflow, and hands-on corroboration.
